description.en: Elin receives the order to cross routine and relay.

description.en: The bulkhead gives way; Voss and security enter.

description.es: Cael y Voss aceptan el resultado limitado.
description.en: Cael and Voss accept the limited result.

description.en: Celestial Ardor advances tiny before Velari Station: several kilometers of lobes, arcs, cavities and changing skin-radiator.

description.es: Una nave emisaria orgánica de 300–600 m se separa de la estación sin escape visible.
description.en: A 300–600 m organic emissary ship separates from the station with no visible escape.

description.es: Luces de la Celestial Ardor, la emisaria y la estación sincronizan un pulso de reconocimiento.
description.en: Lights of the Celestial Ardor, the emissary and the station synchronize a pulse of recognition.

description.es: Puente silencioso; la luz de la emisaria y de la estación orgánica entra en haces estrechos por las pequeñas ventanas reforzadas del casco.
description.en: Silent bridge; light from the emissary and organic station enters in narrow beams through the hull’s small reinforced windows.

description.en: Zao message archived and stopped at its last frame.

description.en: Voss completes the sentence almost to himself.
